kg_agent._comment: Read-only kg-agent literature-QA service on citi-condor. Separate from lkc above (that's session-transcript retrieval) — this answers domain questions from the 8-paper knowledge graph. Tailnet-only, no auth. See kg-agent integration doc, verified 2026-08-17.

summon._comment: Wake-word phrases that trigger the agent. Case-insensitive.

spacy._comment: NER model. Run: python -m spacy download en_core_web_sm

livekit._comment: LiveKit SFU — run: docker run --rm -p 7880:7880 livekit/livekit-server --dev

supabase._comment: url/key intentionally blank — SUPABASE_URL / SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY in .env are the only source of truth (see config.py load()). Leaving these blank means a missing .env fails loudly (empty supabase.url logs 'disabled') instead of silently falling back to a stale hardcoded key.
